name: id-photo
desc: Free, open-source passport photo maker for Windows — crop presets, background swap, print sheets. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT, no watermark.
features: ✅ **Country size presets** — passport, visa and licence dimensions built in with head-position guides
✅ **Background replacement** — a local cutout model swaps any backdrop for the required white or gray
✅ **Print sheet layout** — sixteen photos arranged on a 10x15 sheet with cut marks, at true 300 dpi
✅ **Compliance overlay** — head height and eye line guides sit over the crop so requirements are visible
✅ **Lighting check** — shadow and glare warnings before you print, not after the office rejects it
✅ **No watermark, no upload** — prints are clean and the portrait never leaves the machine
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **id-photo** | Online passport tools | Photoshop | Photo booth |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid per sheet | Subscription | Per session |
| Portraits stay local | **Yes** | Upload | Yes | Yes
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Browser | Installer | N/A
faqQ: how to make a passport photo at home for free on Windows?
faqA: Online makers get their payback through watermarks, uploads and per-sheet fees, and studios charge for a two-minute crop. id-photo applies the right dimensions, swaps the background locally and lays out a print sheet at true dpi. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline.
s1: Dark studio (#121418, blue #2563EB): portrait centered with head-height and eye-line guides overlaid, preset dropdown reading US passport 2x2, background chip set to white.
s2: Print sheet preview: sixteen copies on a 10x15 canvas with cut marks, dpi badge reading 300, printer margin warning resolved in green.
s3: Compliance panel: lighting score, shadow note under the left jaw, retake hint, export PNG and print buttons side by side.
